payload.description_html:
An ideal landscape of the Muschelkalk sub-period (within the Triassic) with reptiles sitting on stones on the seashore, depicting a Nothosaurus on a rock and a "labyrinthodont" on the shore. Wood engraving by Édouard Riou after Marand.
